sentences.en: I was 20, but it was the first time I'd ever been to Boston.
sentences.zh: 我当时20岁，但那是我第一次去波士顿。

sentences.en: Kirsty Paul and another student from England had just arrived at Logan Airport.
sentences.zh: 柯斯蒂·保尔和另一名来自英格兰的学生刚刚抵达洛根机场。

sentences.en: They were about to embark on a new adventure, living in a new city,
sentences.zh: 她们即将开启一段新的冒险，在一个新的城市生活，

sentences.en: working with a very important Harvard professor.
sentences.zh: 与一位非常重要的哈佛教授一起工作。

sentences.en: We stepped off the plane, still a little bit jack-lad, very disorientated,
sentences.zh: 我们刚下飞机，还有点毛躁、晕头转向，

sentences.en: going up to this prestigious academic institute that's famous all over the world.
sentences.zh: 即将走进这个闻名遐迩的顶尖学术机构。

sentences.en: Kirsty could think of only one thing to keep her nervousness in check.
sentences.zh: 柯斯蒂能想到的唯一一件事就是压制内心的紧张。

sentences.en: She had corresponded with a graduate student, Maureen Brinkworth,
sentences.zh: 她曾与一名叫莫琳·布林克沃斯的硕博生通过信，

sentences.en: and Maureen was to be her supervisor and her mentor.
sentences.zh: 而莫琳将成为她的导师和引路人。

sentences.en: Maureen was also going to be Kirsty's lifeline,
sentences.zh: 莫琳也将成为柯斯蒂的救命稻草，

sentences.en: someone who would help her navigate not just the halls of Harvard, but the streets of Boston.
sentences.zh: 一个不仅能帮她熟悉哈佛校园，还能帮她熟悉波士顿街道的人。

sentences.en: So we stumbled to the place where she said she was going to be,
sentences.zh: 所以我们跌跌撞撞地来到了她说的那地方，

sentences.en: so she said she'll be in Harvard Square opposite a certain restaurant.
sentences.zh: 她说她会在哈佛广场对面的一家餐厅等我们。

sentences.en: And so we find it, and then we see her, and we're just so nervous,
sentences.zh: 然后我们找到了，看到了她，我们当时紧张极了，

sentences.en: but Maureen just had this massive big smile,
sentences.zh: 但莫琳脸上带着灿烂的笑容，

sentences.en: and she just kind of puts you at ease straight away.
sentences.zh: 她一下子就让你放松了下来。

sentences.en: She was like, I'm so excited to meet you, you know, welcome.
sentences.zh: 她说，我很高兴见到你们，欢迎欢迎。

sentences.en: And then she took us around.
sentences.zh: 然后她带着我们四处转了转。

sentences.en: And with that, the ice was broken.
sentences.zh: 就这样，气氛破冰了。

sentences.en: Over the next few months, Maureen became more than a mentor to Kirsty.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，莫琳对柯斯蒂来说不仅仅是一位导师。

sentences.en: She became her friend.
sentences.zh: 她成了她的朋友。

sentences.en: But there was something else that was interesting here.
sentences.zh: 但这里还有一些更有趣的事情。

sentences.en: This kind of friendship between student and teacher
sentences.zh: 这种师生之间的友谊

sentences.en: was also the subject of the research that Kirsty and Maureen were conducting
sentences.zh: 也是柯斯蒂和莫琳正在进行的研究的主题，

sentences.en: along with Harvard professor Hunter Gelbach.
sentences.zh: 合作者还有哈佛教授亨特·格尔巴克。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: In this episode, we're going to talk about the relationships between students and mentors.
sentences.zh: 在这一集里，我们将探讨学生与导师之间的关系。

sentences.en: The bond that Maureen and Kirsty developed made a huge difference in Kirsty's life.
sentences.zh: 莫琳和柯斯蒂建立的这种纽带对柯斯蒂的生活产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Now, I can relate to this.
sentences.zh: 现在，我对此深有同感。

sentences.en: I've had wonderful mentors and teachers,
sentences.zh: 我曾遇到过非常优秀的导师和老师，

sentences.en: and I know what a difference a great teacher can make.
sentences.zh: 我知道一位好老师能带来多大的改变。

sentences.en: But what about all those students and teachers who don't have that connection?
sentences.zh: 但是，那些没有建立这种联系的学生和老师又该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: Today, we're going to tell you about new research that shows
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将向大家介绍一项新的研究，该研究表明

sentences.en: that when you don't have that natural spark of chemistry,
sentences.zh: 当你没有那种天然的化学反应时，

sentences.en: closed relationships between teachers and students can be engineered.
sentences.zh: 老师和学生之间紧密的关系是可以人为构建的。

sentences.en: And when you do this, it has an incredible positive effect.
sentences.zh: 当你这样做时，会产生令人难以置信的积极效果。

sentences.en: Stay with us to find out what Maureen, Hunter, and Kirsty learned together.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听，了解莫琳、亨特和柯斯蒂共同学到了什么。

sentences.en: One lovely autumn day, I was biking along with my daughter and a friend of hers in the bike trailer.
sentences.zh: 在一个美好的秋日，我和女儿以及她的一位坐在自行车拖斗里的朋友一起骑车。

sentences.en: And my wife and I had had these sort of ongoing conversations.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子一直在讨论类似的话题。

sentences.en: My daughter's about three at this point, wondering, you know, what actually goes into friendship at age three?
sentences.zh: 当时我女儿大约三岁，我们在想，三岁时的友谊到底包含什么？

sentences.en: Why has my daughter taken a particular shine to this girl as opposed to some other kid in the class?
sentences.zh: 为什么我女儿偏偏对这个女孩另眼相看，而不是班上的其他孩子？

sentences.en: That's Hunter Gelbach, Maureen and Kirsty's professor at the Harvard Graduate School of Education.
sentences.zh: 那是亨特·格尔巴克，莫琳和柯斯蒂在哈佛教育学院的教授。

sentences.en: And as I'm biking along, I feel like I have figured out the answer to this question
sentences.zh: 当我骑着车时，我觉得自己已经找到了这个问题的答案，

sentences.en: because I hear the following conversation.
sentences.zh: 因为我听到了以下这段对话。

sentences.en: So, my daughter says, I like ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我女儿说，我喜欢冰淇淋。

sentences.en: The friend says, I like ice cream.
sentences.zh: 朋友说，我也喜欢冰淇淋。

sentences.en: My daughter says, I like blueberries.
sentences.zh: 我女儿说，我喜欢蓝莓。

sentences.en: The friend says, me too.
sentences.zh: 朋友说，我也是。

sentences.en: I like chocolate ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。

sentences.en: You can kind of see where this is going.
sentences.zh: 你大概能猜到接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: I like chocolate ice cream, too.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。

sentences.en: The friend at this point says, I have a dog.
sentences.zh: 此时朋友说，我有一只狗。

sentences.en: I like my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: Now it actually gets sort of interesting.
sentences.zh: 接下来事情变得有点意思了。

sentences.en: So, ever since age two, my daughter's been petrified of dogs
sentences.zh: 自从两岁起，我女儿就对狗感到极度恐惧，

sentences.en: since there was this little pug that jumped up on her and knocked her over.
sentences.zh: 因为曾有一只小哈巴狗扑到她身上把她撞倒过。

sentences.en: So, my daughter kind of shifts the category from dog to pets.
sentences.zh: 所以，我女儿把“狗”这个类别转换成了“宠物”。

sentences.en: And so, she replies, I have a pet frog.
sentences.zh: 于是她回答，我有一只宠物青蛙。

sentences.en: I like my frog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的青蛙。

sentences.en: The friend continues, I don't like pizza.
sentences.zh: 朋友接着说，我不喜欢披萨。

sentences.en: I don't like pizza.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢披萨。

sentences.en: So, now she's just plain lying.
sentences.zh: 所以，她现在纯粹是在撒谎。

sentences.en: The friend says, I don't like blueberries.
sentences.zh: 朋友说，我不喜欢蓝莓。

sentences.en: I don't like blueberries anymore either.
sentences.zh: 我也不喜欢蓝莓了。

sentences.en: So, anyway, the point being, as I'm huffing and puffing on the bike,
sentences.zh: 总之，我想说的是，当我气喘吁吁地骑着自行车时，

sentences.en: it seems like what goes into friendships or relationships,
sentences.zh: 似乎友谊或人际关系中包含的因素是——

sentences.en: and obviously I'm oversimplifying a little bit,
sentences.zh: 当然我有点过于简单化了——

sentences.en: is that they have stuff in common.
sentences.zh: 就是他们有共同点。

sentences.en: So, they go through all these crazy machinations
sentences.zh: 因此，他们经历所有这些疯狂的尝试，

sentences.en: to establish that they are similar to each other
sentences.zh: 来证明他们彼此相似，

sentences.en: in all these, you know, what would seem like kind of superficial ways.
sentences.zh: 通过所有这些在你看来可能有点表面的方式。

sentences.en: Hunter realized that the conversation he had overheard
sentences.zh: 亨特意识到他无意中听到的这段对话，

sentences.en: had bigger implications than just friendships between three-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 其意义远不止于三岁小孩之间的友谊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, let's back up a little bit.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们回溯一下。

sentences.en: So, I had had a sort of primary research interest for a long, long time
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间以来，我的主要研究兴趣之一

sentences.en: in looking at social perspective taking.
sentences.zh: 是研究社会视角采择。

sentences.en: So, how do teachers and students in particular kind of figure out
sentences.zh: 具体来说，老师和学生是如何弄清楚

sentences.en: what each other is thinking and feeling?
sentences.zh: 彼此在想什么和感受什么的？

sentences.en: And so, I had a graduate student who was someone I worked with very closely
sentences.zh: 因此，我有一个长期紧密合作的研究生，莫琳·布林克沃斯，

sentences.en: for a long, long time, Maureen Brinkworth,
sentences.zh: 她对师生关系非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: who was really interested in teacher-student relationships.
sentences.zh: 所以，这似乎是一个非常自然的结合，

sentences.en: And so, this seemed like a really natural combination
sentences.zh: 去研究我们如何进行这种日常的读心术，

sentences.en: to look at this sort of how do we do this everyday mind reading
sentences.zh: 学生和老师在课堂上是如何对彼此这样做的，

sentences.en: and how are students and teachers doing this with each other in the classroom
sentences.zh: 以及他们的关系有多好。

sentences.en: and how good are their relationships.
sentences.zh: 为了他心中的实验，

sentences.en: For the experiment he had in mind,
sentences.zh: 亨特为九年级班级的学生和老师设计了一份调查问卷。

sentences.en: Hunter created a survey for students and teachers of a ninth-grade class.
sentences.zh: 该问卷试图找出

sentences.en: The questionnaire attempted to pinpoint things
sentences.zh: 老师和学生共同拥有的东西。

sentences.en: that teachers and students had in common.
sentences.zh: 研究人员在寻找各种联系。

sentences.en: The researchers were looking for all kinds of connections.
sentences.zh: 他们提出了各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: They asked a range of questions.
sentences.zh: 从课堂相关的内容到课堂之外的内容，

sentences.en: Classroom-relevant stuff to outside-the-classroom stuff,
sentences.zh: 从个人兴趣到学科相关的内容。

sentences.en: personal to subject-matter-related sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 其中几个问题直击人们的价值观。

sentences.en: Several of them kind of speak to people's values.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当广泛的横断面。

sentences.en: So, it was a pretty broad cross-section.
sentences.zh: 研究人员有选择地与老师和学生分享了一些例子，

sentences.en: The researchers selectively shared examples with the teachers and students
sentences.zh: 这些例子表明他们有共同点。

sentences.en: that suggested they both had things in common.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个觉得自己和学生没有共同点的老师，

sentences.en: So, a teacher who felt she had nothing in common with a student
sentences.zh: 可能会发现他们俩有着相同的幽默感。

sentences.en: might discover they both had the same sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 或者一个觉得老师来自火星的学生，

sentences.en: Or a student who felt like his teacher was from Mars
sentences.zh: 可能会发现他们都喜欢橄榄球。

sentences.en: might discover they both liked football.
sentences.zh: 当亨特检查那些被引导发现自己与老师有共同点的学生的评分时，

sentences.en: When Hunter examined the scores of students who had been induced to see
sentences.zh: 他发现了一件令人惊奇的事。

sentences.en: that they had things in common with their teachers,
sentences.zh: 师生关系变得更融洽了。

sentences.en: he found something astonishing.
sentences.zh: 随着关系的改善，学生们，尤其是少数族裔学生，

sentences.en: The relationships between teachers and students got stronger.
sentences.zh: 突然开始在课堂上表现得更好。

sentences.en: And as they did, students, especially minorities,
sentences.zh: 然后，当我们考察这些黑人和拉丁裔学生的学业成绩时，

sentences.en: suddenly started to perform better in class.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，当他们处于实验组时，

sentences.en: Then when we look at academic achievement with respect to these Black and Latino students,
sentences.zh: 他们的成绩提高了大约0.4个等级，

sentences.en: what we find is that when they're in the treatment group,
sentences.zh: 这意味着该校的成绩差距缩小了60%以上。

sentences.en: their grades go up by about 0.4 of a letter grade,
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: which translates into over 60% plus reduction in the achievement gap at the school.
sentences.zh: 这个简单的干预措施弥合了60%的成绩差距。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，教育工作者一直在努力寻找缩小这一差距的方法，

sentences.en: This simple intervention closed 60% of the achievement gap.
sentences.zh: 因为这是美国教育中最持久、最令人不安的不平等现象之一。

sentences.en: Educators have been struggling for decades to find ways to close this gap
sentences.zh: 当然，我并不是暗示这单一的干预措施就能解决所有问题。

sentences.en: because it's one of the most persistent and disturbing disparities in American education.
sentences.zh: 亨特的实验还必须在其他学校、

sentences.en: Now, I don't want to imply that this one intervention can fix the whole problem.
sentences.zh: 由其他学生和其他老师进行复制验证。

sentences.en: Hunter's experiment is going to have to be replicated at other schools,
sentences.zh: 但我认为这个想法非常有前景。

sentences.en: with other students and other teachers.
sentences.zh: 它成本低、操作简便，并且建立在大量其他研究的基础之上，

sentences.en: But I think the idea is really promising.
sentences.zh: 这些研究发现，强有力的师生关系能带来改变。

sentences.en: It's inexpensive, it's easy, and it builds on top of a mountain of other research
sentences.zh: 我问亨特，为什么黑人和拉丁裔学生能从这种干预中获益最多。

sentences.en: that finds strong relationships between students and teachers make a difference.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: I asked Hunter why Black and Latinos might benefit the most from this kind of intervention.
sentences.zh: 我想我目前的最佳猜测是，当老师们——

sentences.en: So it's a hugely important question.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，这些都是白人、欧裔美国人老师——

sentences.en: I think my best guess at this point is that when teachers,
sentences.zh: 走进教室时，

sentences.en: and, you know, for the most part, these are white, European-American teachers,
sentences.zh: 他们可能并没有意识到自己与黑人和拉丁裔学生会有多少共同点。

sentences.en: they walk into the classroom,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能会对他们最终在课堂上的教学方式产生影响。

sentences.en: they may not perceive that they would necessarily have much in common
sentences.zh: 但只要我们给他们这个小小的支点，告诉他们，

sentences.en: with the Black and Latino students.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你知道吗，你们俩有这个共同点，

sentences.en: You know, that may have implications for how they then end up teaching in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 或者你们在这件事上有相似的感受，你们有相同的价值观，

sentences.en: But as soon as we give them this little anchor and say,
sentences.zh: 这就给他们提供了一个切入点或桥梁，让他们能够以富有成效的方式与这些学生建立联系，

sentences.en: hey, you know what, you guys have this in common,
sentences.zh: 就像他们自己可能已经摸索出的那样，

sentences.en: or you really feel similarly around this, you share these values,
sentences.zh: 或者他们与白人和亚裔学生相处时做的那样。

sentences.en: it gives them a hook or an entry point to connect with these students in a productive way
sentences.zh: 研究中有一个亨特未曾预料到的转折。

sentences.en: as they might have, you know, kind of figured out or done on their own
sentences.zh: 当师生关系得到加强时，学生的学业表现明显更好。

sentences.en: with the white and Asian students.
sentences.zh: 但当亨特询问学生这些关系是否更加紧密时，

sentences.en: There was one twist in the research that Hunter had not anticipated.
sentences.zh: 学生们大多耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: Students clearly did better academically when their relationships with teachers were strengthened.
sentences.zh: 而且，说实话，

sentences.en: But when Hunter asked students about whether those relationships were stronger,
sentences.zh: 我其实有点恼火，因为学生们并没有因为我专门为他们设计的干预措施

sentences.en: the students mostly shrugged.
sentences.zh: 而觉得与老师更亲近。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'll be honest,
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，几乎可以说加强关系

sentences.en: I was kind of annoyed that the students didn't feel closer to their teachers
sentences.zh: 对老师产生的影响比对学生产生的影响还要大。

sentences.en: as the result of, you know, this intervention that I had put together just for them.
sentences.zh: 我想，对于师生之间的这种连接，

sentences.en: In many ways, it was almost as if strengthening the relationships
sentences.zh: 人们往往默认去思考这对学生有多重要

sentences.en: made a bigger difference to teachers than it did to students.
sentences.zh: 以及他们能从中得到什么。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, with these sort of connections between teachers and students,
sentences.zh: 但对于老师或导师来说，我认为这里面也大有文章。

sentences.en: there's a default to thinking about how important this is for the students
sentences.zh: 我还想补充一点。

sentences.en: and what they get out of it.
sentences.zh: 这种影响是双向的。

sentences.en: But for the teachers or the mentors, you know, I think there's a lot in it too.
sentences.zh: 它不仅关乎学生，也关乎老师。

sentences.en: And I think one of the biggest things I got from my relationship with Maureen...
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我从与莫琳的关系中得到的最大收获之一……

sentences.en: Remember, Maureen?
sentences.zh: 还记得莫琳吗？

sentences.en: That's the woman we told you about earlier in this episode.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们在本期节目早些时候向大家介绍的那位女性。

sentences.en: She helped Hunter conceive the project.
sentences.zh: 她协助亨特构思了这个项目。

sentences.en: She helped design the questionnaires for the ninth grade students.
sentences.zh: 她协助为九年级学生设计了调查问卷。

sentences.en: And the bond she formed with Hunter and with new research assistants such as Kirstie Paul
sentences.zh: 她与亨特以及诸如科斯蒂·保罗等新研究助理建立的纽带

sentences.en: informed the entire direction of the project.
sentences.zh: 为整个项目的方向奠定了基础。

sentences.en: But as the research was wrapping up and getting ready to be published,
sentences.zh: 但随着研究接近尾声并准备发表时，

sentences.en: Maureen's own relationship with the entire research team was changing
sentences.zh: 莫琳与整个研究团队的关系却发生了变化，

sentences.en: because of a personal tragedy that was unfolding in her own life.
sentences.zh: 因为她自己的生活中正在发生一场个人悲剧。

sentences.en: I believe it was shortly after her 30th birthday that she got the initial cancer diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 我记得大约在她30岁生日后不久，她初次被诊断出患有癌症。

sentences.en: Hunter says that Maureen's strength in the face of this tragedy had a profound effect on him.
